## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue if any.

## Validation

Describe checks and results. For numerical changes, include the independently expected result, units, CRS/datums, and a synthetic reproduction. State what remains untested.

## Publication review

- [ ] I reviewed the diff and outgoing commits for private data and credentials.
- [ ] Examples are synthetic and safe to publish; I have permission to share contributed material.
- [ ] I ran `python scripts/check_publication.py` after staging.
- [ ] New tracked paths have explicit `.gitignore` and scanner allowlist entries.
- [ ] Documentation and third-party notices are updated where needed.
